title: Tame the runaway session title
prompt:
The row is 400px wide, and the long title pushes the **Save** button out of it. Using flexbox properties on the items:

- make `.time` a fixed **5rem** column that never grows or shrinks,
- let `.title` take all remaining space and truncate with an **ellipsis** instead of overflowing,
- keep `.save` at its natural size at the end of the row.

The row must not overflow, and the layout should still hold when the title is short.
hints: Something stops the title from shrinking below its text width. Which property sets that floor on flex items?
`flex: 0 0 5rem` gives a fixed column. `flex: 1` plus `min-width: 0` lets the title fill and shrink.
On `.title`: `flex: 1; min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis;`. On `.save`: `flex: none;`.
explanation: Flex items have `min-width: auto`, which keeps them at least as wide as their content; with `white-space: nowrap` that is the whole sentence. `min-width: 0` removes the floor so the title can shrink, and `overflow: hidden` with `text-overflow: ellipsis` turns the clipped text into `…`. `flex: 0 0 5rem` fixes the time column (a plain `width: 5rem` would still shrink), `flex: 1` makes the title absorb leftover space even when it's short, and `flex: none` stops the button from being squeezed.

checks.time-fixed: The time column is exactly 5rem wide
checks.save-at-end: The Save button sits at the end of the row
checks.title-fills: The title fills the space up to the button
checks.ellipsis: The title truncates with an ellipsis
checks.short-title-still-fills: With a short title, the layout still holds
